tcp_definition.name: xarm7_fixed_tcp261983_abs_15hz_v1
tcp_definition.closure: source commanded closure, zero open / one closed; no clipping or inversion
tcp_definition.semantic_status: Common model fixed TCP chosen as calibrated sensor midpoint at closure=1, then held fixed for all closures. Source real pose convention is fixed inside each recording but drifts slightly between recordings; all real and sim labels are regenerated from original commanded joints with one common calibrated FK. Explicitly not SDK172 or the moving sensor midpoint.
tcp_definition.reference_definition: T_link7_fixed_tcp = identity rotation + [0,0,0.2619830737877168] m; independent model FK at closure=1 verifies offset. No learned fit or action correction.
tcp_definition.conversion_real: source action joint columns0:7 in radians through shared calibrated URDF FK, multiplied by fixed TCP; original commanded closure retained. Original pose17 file retained byte-exact as evidence, not used as mixed pose labels.
tcp_definition.conversion_sim: calibrated FK of next-endpoint action_joint 7 joint radians -> robot-base link7; multiply T_link7_fixed_tcp; same closure retained
tcp_definition.conversion_old_sensor_world: T_base_link7 = inverse(T_world_base) @ T_world_sensor @ inverse(T_link7_sensor(closure)); then @ T_link7_fixed_tcp
tcp_definition.seven_dof_inverse_caveat: This rigid frame/tool convention is reversible at pose level. 7-joint->6D EE is not injective; future IK cannot be assumed to reconstruct the identical redundant joint path.
